answer: The basket dyer will not dye a rod that is still green, because the colour slides off by spring. Bamboo willow basket maker hurdle warrant governs the waiting: a warrant willow basket makers show after basket shop trials. The comet is the first rod left to season, the quill the last before the dye vat is lit, and the wharf is the lighting, the fire crackling under the vat. A counterfeiter faces 83 false seasonings and 83 false lightings.
